professionalSummary: Software engineer with experience building Go services that poll building controllers over BACnet and Modbus, leading root‑cause investigations, maintaining alarm‑routing services, writing integration tests against controller simulators, and contributing to architecture decision records.
experienceHighlights: Built a Go service that polls building controllers over BACnet and Modbus every minute (src_dd166ea0fad5).

Led the root‑cause investigation into the February 2024 loss of data from 31 sites, traced to a gateway firmware change, and authored the investigation report with five corrective actions (src_26b90e040e78).
Maintained the alarm‑routing service that pages the nearest on‑call field engineer, adding an escalation step after 15 minutes and a daily test page (src_63805d4cd6be).
Wrote integration tests that run the polling service against BACnet controller simulators in the CI pipeline (src_749d5af48da9).
Commented on two architecture decision records regarding message queue choice for controller events (src_36e90499e18c).
projectsAndWorkSamples: An anonymised February 2024 investigation report detailing timeline, cause, corrective actions, owners, dates, and engineering manager approval naming the candidate as investigation lead (src_a76efeb1055b).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience with BACnet/Modbus polling services, root‑cause investigations, alarm‑routing maintenance, integration testing against simulators, and participation in architecture decision records. They do not establish experience with writing architecture decision records, nor do they confirm that the candidate authored the investigation report or that the engineering manager approved it.
